codeSystems.name: OEAnalyzerOperationalStatus
codeSystems.title: OpenELIS Analyzer Operational Status
codeSystems.description: OpenELIS's own analyzer lifecycle status, sent unchanged (enum name, a plain code with no system) in the analyzer-operational-status extension. This CodeSystem exists only so the IG can bind that code. Device.status carries the FHIR mapping of the same value.
